::: {.callout-note}
**Audience:** instructors / content authors.  
Source: `Qualifikationskriterien_MfB_english 1.odt` (BridgeCourse folder).  
QuBi I **cannot** cover every MfB learning goal of years 1–2. The aim is to **touch** many codes deliberately, deepen some, and leave the rest to parallel courses (especially programming and statistics).
:::

## MfB codes (reminder)

| Code | Area |
|---|---|
| **LOG** | Logic and critical thinking (assumptions, misleading visuals, hypotheses, AI ethics) |
| **MATH** | Calculus and linear algebra (derivatives, DEs, stability, matrices) |
| **PROB** | Probability (distributions, LLN/CLT intuition, simple stochastic processes) |
| **DAT** | Data science (R processing/viz, structures, FAIR; ML/PCA in glimpses) |
| **PROG** | Programming (functions, loops, simulation, reproducible notebooks) |
| **STAT** | Statistics (descriptive; inference mostly elsewhere) |
| **MOD** | Mathematical modelling (discrete/continuous; deterministic/stochastic; assumptions) |

---

## Where QuBi I picks up each code

| Code | Strong focus in QuBi I | Lighter / outlook | Mostly elsewhere |
|---|---|---|---|
| **MOD** | W2–4 ecological models; W5–8 deterministic evolution; W9–11 establishment & rescue | Stability ideas for logistic / LV | Full phase-plane theory |
| **PROG** | Every week: function → vector → loop; Quarto notebooks | Matrices for replicates (W9–11) | Python track; software engineering |
| **LOG** | Model assumptions; honest model–data comparison; checkpoint talks; **AI policy** | Spotting bad visuals in microbiome block | Formal fallacies |
| **DAT** | W12–14 load/join/visualise complex tables | FAIR habits (cite data, be transparent) | Excel track; full ML/PCA course |
| **MATH** | Discrete additive updates $N_{t+1}=N_t+f(N_t)$; ODE mention only | Equilibrium intuition (logistic, selection) | Formal derivatives, eigenvalues, Leslie |
| **PROB** | Establishment as stochastic fate; rescue probabilities; replicate cultures | LLN intuition via many sims | Distribution theory, Markov homework |
| **STAT** | Qualitative pattern reading; means of replicates | p-values / CI only if a data story needs them | Dedicated statistics course |

## Week overview

| Week | Topic | Primary MfB codes |
|-----:|------|---|
| 1 | Bajau → Tibetans / evidence chain | LOG |
| 2 | Gause PP → discrete LV → code | MOD, PROG, LOG |
| 3 | Exclusion, bistability, predator-mediated coexistence | MOD, PROG, DAT |
| 4 | Game theory / RPS lizards; **Checkpoint A** | MOD, PROG, LOG |
| 5 | HWE, HapMap, Wahlund | MOD, PROG, LOG |
| 6 | Selection and local adaptation | MOD, PROG, LOG |
| 7 | Maintaining variation | MOD, PROG, LOG |
| 8 | Synthesis; **Checkpoint B** | MOD, LOG |
| 9 | Establishment probabilities | MOD, PROB, PROG |
| 10 | Evolutionary rescue | MOD, PROB, PROG |
| 11 | Rescue synthesis; **Checkpoint C** | MOD, PROB, LOG |
| 12 | Load complex microbiome data | DAT, PROG, LOG |
| 13 | Visualise communities | DAT, LOG, PROG |
| 14 | Visual story; **Checkpoint D** (short synthesis) | DAT, LOG |

**Checkpoints** deliberately train **LOG** (assumptions, limits) and communication on top of the block’s content codes.

---

## Authoring rules

1. Prefer **one clear MfB-aligned learning goal** per week over claiming a whole code domain.  
2. Keep new maths **interpretive** unless parallel maths already covers the formal base.  
3. Every checkpoint should require: assumption + figure + “what we do not claim” (**LOG**).  
4. The AI policy covers MfB’s ethical-AI goal (**LOG** / **DAT** / **PROG**).  
5. Do not promise mastery of PCA/ML, full DE stability proofs, or inferential statistics inside QuBi I.

---

## Deliberately accepted gaps

- Full inferential **STAT** pipeline  
- Full eigenvalues / Leslie under **MATH**  
- Machine learning under **DAT** beyond an optional outlook  
- Gillespie SSA (named in MfB MOD examples) — optional depth, not core  

If a gap is deepened, prefer an **optional notebook appendix** over a new required week.
